name: Bulbasaur
fact: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

name: Ivysaur
fact: If the bud on its back starts to smell sweet, it is evidence that the large flower will soon bloom.

name: Venusaur
fact: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

name: Charmander
fact: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Charmeleon
fact: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

name: Charizard
fact: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: Squirtle
fact: The shell is soft when it is born. It soon becomes so resilient, prodding fingers will bounce off it.

name: Wartortle
fact: When tapped on its head, this Pokémon will pull it in, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

name: Blastoise
fact: Once it takes aim at its enemy, it blasts out water with even more force than a fire hose.

name: Caterpie
fact: Perhaps because it would like to grow up quickly, it has a voracious appetite, eating a hundred leaves a day.

name: Metapod
fact: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

name: Butterfree
fact: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

name: Weedle
fact: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.

name: Kakuna
fact: Nearly incapable of movement, it leans against stout trees while waiting for its evolution.

name: Beedrill
fact: It has three poison barbs. The barb on its tail secretes the most powerful poison.

name: Pidgey
fact: It usually hides in tall grass. Because it dislikes fighting, it protects itself by kicking up sand.

name: Pidgeotto
fact: It has outstanding vision. However high it flies, it is able to distinguish the movements of its prey.

name: Pidgeot
fact: By flapping its wings with all its might, Pidgeot can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.

name: Rattata
fact: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.

name: Raticate
fact: Its hind feet are webbed, so it's a strong swimmer. It can cross rivers and sometimes even oceans.

name: Spearow
fact: Very protective of its territory, it flaps its short wings busily to dart around at high speed.

name: Fearow
fact: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

name: Ekans
fact: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

name: Arbok
fact: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.

name: Pikachu
fact: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.

name: Raichu
fact: When electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes feisty. It also glows in the dark.

name: Sandshrew
fact: It can roll its body into a ball. It moves through the desert by rolling at high speeds.

name: Sandslash
fact: Thanks to its thick claws, it's good at climbing trees. There are plenty of Sandslash that park themselves in trees and go right to sleep.

name: Nidoran♀
fact: Small and very docile, it protects itself with its small, poisonous horn when attacked.

name: Nidorina
fact: When resting deep in its burrow, its barbs always retract. This is proof that it is relaxed.

name: Nidoqueen
fact: Nidoqueen is better at defense than offense. With scales like armor, this Pokémon will shield its children from any kind of attack.

name: Nidoran♂
fact: Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs when angered.

name: Nidorino
fact: With a horn that's harder than diamond, this Pokémon goes around shattering boulders as it searches for a moon stone.

name: Nidoking
fact: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

name: Clefairy
fact: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefable
fact: Its hearing is so acute it can hear a pin drop over half a mile away. It lives on quiet mountains.

name: Vulpix
fact: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Ninetales
fact: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

name: Jigglypuff
fact: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

name: Wigglytuff
fact: When it gets angry, it inhales with all its might, and its body gradually inflates. Sometimes they can grow 20 times larger!

name: Zubat
fact: Zubat live in caves, down where the sun's light won't reach. In the morning, they gather together to keep each other warm as they sleep.

name: Golbat
fact: Every once in a while, you'll see a Golbat that's missing some fangs. This happens when hunger drives it to try biting a Steel-type Pokémon.

name: Oddish
fact: It may be mistaken for a clump of weeds. If you try to yank it out of the ground, it shrieks horribly.

name: Gloom
fact: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

name: Vileplume
fact: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

name: Paras
fact: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back soak up most of the food.

name: Parasect
fact: It stays mostly in dark, damp places, the preference not of the bug, but of the big mushroom on its back.

name: Venonat
fact: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

name: Venomoth
fact: The dustlike scales covering its wings are color-coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

name: Diglett
fact: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

name: Dugtrio
fact: While the three of them normally get along splendidly, on rare occasions a huge fight will break out over which head gets to eat first.

name: Meowth
fact: It loves to collect shiny things. If it's in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.

name: Persian
fact: The gem in its forehead glows on its own! It walks with all the grace and elegance of a proud queen.

name: Psyduck
fact: It has mystical powers but doesn't recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.

name: Golduck
fact: A professional swimmer, it can continue swimming for two days straight by waving its long tail skillfully.

name: Mankey
fact: If one gets angry, all the others around it will get angry, so silence is a rare visitor in a troop of Mankey.

name: Primeape
fact: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

name: Growlithe
fact: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.

name: Arcanine
fact: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.

name: Poliwag
fact: The direction of the spiral on the belly differs by area. It is more adept at swimming than walking.

name: Poliwhirl
fact: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.

name: Poliwrath
fact: Poliwrath in the Alola region are strong swimmers that use the breaststroke. Many children learn to swim by imitating Poliwrath.

name: Abra
fact: Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its teleportations go.

name: Kadabra
fact: Many odd things happen if this Pokémon is close by. For example, it makes clocks run backward.

name: Alakazam
fact: If it trusts someone deeply, it will let them have one of its spoons. Anything you eat with that spoon is apparently delicious.

name: Machop
fact: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke
fact: It can lift a dump truck with one hand. Using that power, it helps people with heavy jobs.

name: Machamp
fact: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

name: Bellsprout
fact: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

name: Weepinbell
fact: Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt because it also oozes a protective fluid.

name: Victreebel
fact: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honey-like scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.

name: Tentacool
fact: It can sometimes be found all dry and shriveled up on a beach. Toss it back into the sea to revive it.

name: Tentacruel
fact: It communicates with others of its kind by lighting up the red orbs on its head. When the orbs are blinking, it's a warning sign.

name: Geodude
fact: There are plenty of them to be found along any road. A scholar with too much free time once counted a hundred of them along a single route.

name: Graveler
fact: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

name: Golem
fact: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

name: Ponyta
fact: If you've been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

name: Rapidash
fact: With incredible acceleration, it reaches its top speed of 150 mph after running just 10 steps.

name: Slowpoke
fact: There are some places where Slowpoke is worshiped because of a long-standing belief that whenever Slowpoke yawns, it rains.

name: Slowbro
fact: Whenever Shellder bites down hard on its tail, it gives Slowbro a flash of inspiration...which it forgets a moment later.

name: Magnemite
fact: They gather in places where electricity is available. They can be found clinging to the steel towers used to support power lines.

name: Magneton
fact: When three Magnemite link together, their brains also become one. They do not become three times more intelligent.

name: Farfetch’d
fact: If it eats the plant stalk it carries as emergency rations, it runs off in search of a new stalk.

name: Doduo
fact: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

name: Dodrio
fact: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

name: Seel
fact: The colder it gets, the better it feels. It joyfully swims around oceans so cold that they are filled with floating ice.

name: Dewgong
fact: It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise in its body temperature helps its digestion.

name: Grimer
fact: The wastewater coming from factories is clean these days, so Grimer have nothing to eat. They're said to be on the verge of extinction.

name: Muk
fact: The stench it gives off will make your nose scrunch up. Still, there are Muk fans who think that's a good thing.

name: Shellder
fact: The sand that accumulates inside its shell eventually becomes a pearl. But the pearl gets in the way, so it spits it out and discards it.

name: Cloyster
fact: Slowpoke tails are its favorite food. It has even been known to come up on land to look for Slowpoke from time to time.

name: Gastly
fact: Although Gastly is barely visible, when it's near, a faint sweet smell lingers.

name: Haunter
fact: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.

name: Gengar
fact: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar's doing.

name: Onix
fact: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.

name: Drowzee
fact: It finds really fun dreams tasty. When it makes friends with people, it may show them the most delicious dreams it's ever eaten.

name: Hypno
fact: There are some Hypno that assist doctors with patients who can't sleep at night in hospitals.

name: Krabby
fact: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

name: Kingler
fact: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it's not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.

name: Voltorb
fact: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

name: Electrode
fact: It is dangerous. If it has too much electricity and has nothing to do, it amuses itself by exploding.

name: Exeggcute
fact: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

name: Exeggutor
fact: Each of its three heads has its own thoughts. When they want to go in different directions, Exeggutor becomes unable to move.

name: Cubone
fact: It wears a bone helmet and swings a bone club. Nobody has ever seen the face underneath!

name: Marowak
fact: They thump their bones rhythmically to communicate among themselves. There are nearly 50 different rhythmic patterns.

name: Hitmonlee
fact: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.

name: Hitmonchan
fact: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

name: Lickitung
fact: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.

name: Koffing
fact: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.

name: Weezing
fact: Top-grade perfume is made using its internal poison gases by diluting them to the highest level.

name: Rhyhorn
fact: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.

name: Rhydon
fact: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Chansey
fact: A gentle and kindhearted Pokémon that shares its nutritious eggs if it sees an injured Pokémon.

name: Tangela
fact: The blue vines shrouding its body are covered in a growth of fine hair. It is known to be ticklish.

name: Kangaskhan
fact: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.

name: Horsea
fact: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.

name: Seadra
fact: Touching the back fin causes numbness. It hooks its tail to coral to stay in place while sleeping.

name: Goldeen
fact: The way it swims along fluttering its dress-like fins has earned it the name "princess of the water."

name: Seaking
fact: To attract females, males dance on the river's floor. The females gather around the male that dances most gracefully.

name: Staryu
fact: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you'll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.

name: Starmie
fact: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

name: Mr. Mime
fact: It creates invisible walls with its pantomiming. If you don't act impressed, it will attack you with a double slap!

name: Scyther
fact: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

name: Jynx
fact: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

name: Electabuzz
fact: With the coming of a storm, many of these Pokémon will gather under tall trees and sit there waiting for lightning to strike.

name: Magmar
fact: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

name: Pinsir
fact: Although it's tough, it can't handle cold well. When night falls, it buries itself in leafage and sleeps.

name: Tauros
fact: A rowdy Pokémon with a lot of stamina. Once running, it won't stop until it hits something.

name: Magikarp
fact: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

name: Gyarados
fact: The energy from evolution stimulated its brain cells strongly, causing it to become very ferocious.

name: Lapras
fact: A gentle soul that can understand human speech. It can ferry people across the sea on its back.

name: Ditto
fact: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.

name: Eevee
fact: Its genes are easily influenced by its surroundings. Even its face starts to look like that of its Trainer.

name: Vaporeon
fact: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

name: Jolteon
fact: Its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity. The crackling sound of electricity can be heard when it exhales.

name: Flareon
fact: When it catches prey or finds berries, it breathes fire on them until they're well done, and then it gobbles them up.

name: Porygon
fact: It can convert its body into digital data, which enables it to enter cyberspace.

name: Omanyte
fact: Revived from an ancient fossil, this Pokémon uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.

name: Omastar
fact: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.

name: Kabuto
fact: A Pokémon that was recovered from a fossil. It used the eyes on its back while hiding on the seafloor.

name: Kabutops
fact: In the water, it tucks in its limbs to become more compact, then it wiggles its shell to swim fast.

name: Aerodactyl
fact: It flew through the open skies over the ancient continent as if they were its own. When it touched ground, its walk was weak and slow.

name: Snorlax
fact: It eats nearly 900 pounds of food every day. It starts nodding off while eating—and continues to eat even while it's asleep.

name: Articuno
fact: The magnificent, seemingly translucent wings of this legendary bird Pokémon are said to be made of ice.

name: Zapdos
fact: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It's said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.

name: Moltres
fact: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

name: Dratini
fact: After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.

name: Dragonair
fact: Some say that if you see it at the start of the year, flying through the sky and twisting its body, you'll be healthy all year long.

name: Dragonite
fact: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.

name: Mewtwo
fact: Its DNA is almost the same as Mew's. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.

name: Mew
fact: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

name: Chikorita
fact: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

name: Bayleef
fact: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

name: Meganium
fact: Its breath has the fantastic ability to revive dead plants and flowers.

name: Cyndaquil
fact: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

name: Quilava
fact: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

name: Typhlosion
fact: It attacks using blasts of fire. It creates heat shimmers with intense fire to hide itself.

name: Totodile
fact: This rough critter chomps at any moving object it sees. Turning your back on it is not recommended.

name: Croconaw
fact: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: Feraligatr
fact: Although it has a massive body, its powerful hind legs enable it to move quickly, even on the ground.

name: Sentret
fact: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

name: Furret
fact: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

name: Hoothoot
fact: It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some Trainers use them in place of clocks.

name: Noctowl
fact: If it flips its head upside down, it's a sign that it is engaged in very complex thinking.

name: Ledyba
fact: When the weather turns cold, lots of Ledyba gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.

name: Ledian
fact: It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.

name: Spinarak
fact: Some fishermen weave its sturdy thread into nets to catch fish Pokémon.

name: Ariados
fact: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It's hard to tell which end is which.

name: Crobat
fact: This Pokémon flaps its four wings skillfully. Crobat can fly through cramped caves without needing to slow down.

name: Chinchou
fact: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

name: Lanturn
fact: Should you peer into the ocean at night and see a light shining like the stars, that is Lanturn.

name: Pichu
fact: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

name: Cleffa
fact: On nights with many shooting stars, they gather in packs and dance in circles. If you should see them, something good will happen!

name: Igglybuff
fact: It's always practicing its singing because it wants to improve. Even when it's asleep, it keeps singing in its dreams!

name: Togepi
fact: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

name: Togetic
fact: It is said to appear in front of kindly people to scatter a glowing down called "joy dust."

name: Natu
fact: The look in its eyes gives the impression that it's carefully observing you. If you approach it, Natu will hop away.

name: Xatu
fact: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

name: Mareep
fact: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

name: Flaaffy
fact: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

name: Ampharos
fact: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

name: Bellossom
fact: Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

name: Marill
fact: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.

name: Azumarill
fact: These Pokémon create air-filled bubbles. When Azurill play in rivers, Azumarill will cover them with these bubbles.

name: Sudowoodo
fact: If a tree branch shakes when there is no wind, it's a Sudowoodo, not a tree. It hides from the rain.

name: Politoed
fact: Although its cries sound like screams, a composer created a beautiful ballad that was influenced by the sounds.

name: Hoppip
fact: It can be carried away on even the gentlest breeze. It may even float all the way to the next town.

name: Skiploom
fact: As soon as it rains, it closes its flower and hides in the shade of a tree to avoid getting wet.

name: Jumpluff
fact: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

name: Aipom
fact: It lives atop giant trees. It wraps its tail around a branch so it won't fall off while asleep.

name: Sunkern
fact: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. Knowing it's weak, it simply feeds until it evolves.

name: Sunflora
fact: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.

name: Yanma
fact: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won't miss prey, even those behind it.

name: Wooper
fact: It lives in cold water, half burying itself in mud at the bottom to sleep.

name: Quagsire
fact: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn't care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

name: Espeon
fact: Its fur is so sensitive, it can sense minute shifts in the air and predict the weather.

name: Umbreon
fact: On the night of a full moon, or when it gets excited, the ring patterns on its body glow yellow.

name: Murkrow
fact: They awaken at dusk and take wing in the twilight, leading to the expression, "Get home before the Murkrow fly."

name: Slowking
fact: Slowking can solve any problem presented to it, but no one can understand a thing Slowking says.

name: Misdreavus
fact: If you hear a sobbing sound emanating from a vacant room, it's undoubtedly a bit of mischief from Misdreavus.

name: Unown
fact: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

name: Wobbuffet
fact: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.

name: Girafarig
fact: While it sleeps, the head on its tail keeps watch. The tail doesn't need to sleep.

name: Pineco
fact: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.

name: Forretress
fact: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

name: Dunsparce
fact: It travels by digging through the ground. Diglett and Dunsparce share one another's tunnels happily.

name: Gligar
fact: It builds its nest on a steep cliff. When it is done gliding, it hops along the ground back to its nest.

name: Steelix
fact: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

name: Snubbull
fact: Despite its intimidating face, it's quite cowardly. Its desperate attempts to appear threatening make it popular with people.

name: Granbull
fact: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.

name: Qwilfish
fact: When faced with a larger opponent, it swallows as much water as it can to match the opponent's size.

name: Scizor
fact: It uses its wings to adjust its body temperature. Otherwise, its metal body would become too hot and melt in the heat of battle.

name: Shuckle
fact: It stores berries in its shell. The berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.

name: Heracross
fact: With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

name: Sneasel
fact: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

name: Teddiursa
fact: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they're soaked with honey.

name: Ursaring
fact: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.

name: Slugma
fact: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.

name: Magcargo
fact: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.

name: Swinub
fact: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

name: Piloswine
fact: Its shaggy coat makes it unable to see. It checks surroundings with its sensitive nose instead.

name: Corsola
fact: Coral branches grow from its head. They break off quite easily, but they grow back in about three days.

name: Remoraid
fact: Also known as the "sniper of the seas," its water gun can hit prey without fail from over 300 feet away.

name: Octillery
fact: It usually sleeps in caves. The pitch-black ink that Octillery spits is also used for cooking.

name: Delibird
fact: It wraps food in its tail to carry it around. The Delibird with the biggest tail is the boss of the flock!

name: Mantine
fact: Many people have taken up surfing because they admire how magnificently Mantine swims.

name: Skarmory
fact: Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy, but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles an hour!

name: Houndour
fact: They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.

name: Houndoom
fact: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

name: Kingdra
fact: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

name: Phanpy
fact: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.

name: Donphan
fact: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

name: Porygon2
fact: After artificial intelligence was implemented in Porygon2, the Pokémon began using a strange language that only other Porygon2 understand.

name: Stantler
fact: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.

name: Smeargle
fact: It draws symbols all over the place to mark its territory. In towns with many Smeargle, the walls are covered in graffiti.

name: Tyrogue
fact: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

name: Hitmontop
fact: After doing a handstand to throw off the opponent's timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.

name: Smoochum
fact: If its face gets even slightly dirty, Smoochum will bathe immediately. But if its body gets dirty, Smoochum doesn't really seem to care.

name: Elekid
fact: When it hears the crash of thunder, Elekid's mood improves. It can be useful to record that sound and play it when Elekid's feeling down.

name: Magby
fact: When flames drip from its nose, that means it has a cold. Have it lie down for a nice rest in some magma.

name: Miltank
fact: It is said that kids who drink Miltank's milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

name: Blissey
fact: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

name: Raikou
fact: A Pokémon that races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

name: Entei
fact: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

name: Suicune
fact: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

name: Larvitar
fact: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

name: Pupitar
fact: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

name: Tyranitar
fact: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

name: Lugia
fact: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

name: Ho-Oh
fact: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

name: Celebi
fact: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

name: Treecko
fact: It quickly scales even vertical walls. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day's weather.

name: Grovyle
fact: It leaps from tree branch to tree branch quite swiftly. It shows astounding agility.

name: Sceptile
fact: The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp as swords. It agilely leaps about the branches of trees to strike.

name: Torchic
fact: Inside its body is a place where it keeps a small flame. Hug it! It will be as warm as a hot-water bottle.

name: Combusken
fact: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

name: Blaziken
fact: It can clear a 30-story building in a leap. Its fiery punches scorch its foes.

name: Mudkip
fact: Its power can crush boulders. It rests by covering itself with mud at the bottom of a river.

name: Marshtomp
fact: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.

name: Swampert
fact: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

name: Poochyena
fact: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

name: Mightyena
fact: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

name: Zigzagoon
fact: It gets interested in everything, which is why it zigs and zags. It is good at finding items.

name: Linoone
fact: When running in a straight line, it can top 60 miles per hour. However, it has a tough time with curved roads.

name: Wurmple
fact: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a Starly, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.

name: Silcoon
fact: It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

name: Beautifly
fact: Beautifly's favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this Pokémon, just leave a potted flower by an open window.

name: Cascoon
fact: Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.

name: Dustox
fact: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

name: Lotad
fact: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can't swim.

name: Lombre
fact: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

name: Ludicolo
fact: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

name: Seedot
fact: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

name: Nuzleaf
fact: Nuzleaf live in densely overgrown forests. They occasionally venture out of the forest to startle people.

name: Shiftry
fact: Shiftry is a mysterious Pokémon that is said to live atop towering trees dating back over a thousand years.

name: Taillow
fact: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

name: Swellow
fact: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.

name: Wingull
fact: Wingull has the habit of carrying prey and valuables in its beak and hiding them in all sorts of locations.

name: Pelipper
fact: It acts as a delivery service by carrying small Pokémon in its bill. It bobs on the waves to rest.

name: Ralts
fact: It uses the horns on its head to sense human emotions. It is said to appear in front of cheerful people.

name: Kirlia
fact: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

name: Gardevoir
fact: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

name: Surskit
fact: If it's in a pinch, it will secrete a sweet liquid from the tip of its head. Syrup made from gathering that liquid is tasty on bread.

name: Masquerain
fact: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction, to and fro and sideways.

name: Shroomish
fact: If it senses danger, it scatters spores from the top of its head to protect itself.

name: Breloom
fact: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

name: Slakoth
fact: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.

name: Vigoroth
fact: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.

name: Slaking
fact: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

name: Nincada
fact: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

name: Ninjask
fact: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

name: Shedinja
fact: A strange Pokémon—it flies without moving its wings, has a hollow shell for a body, and does not breathe.

name: Whismur
fact: When Whismur cries, the sound of its own voice startles it, making the Pokémon cry even louder.

name: Loudred
fact: Loudred's ears serve as speakers, and they can put out sound waves powerful enough to blow away a house.

name: Exploud
fact: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

name: Makuhita
fact: It practices its slaps by repeatedly slapping tree trunks. It has been known to slap an Exeggutor and get flung away.

name: Hariyama
fact: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

name: Azurill
fact: Its tail is filled with nutrients necessary for growth. It plays by bouncing on its tail.

name: Nosepass
fact: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check Nosepass to get their bearings.

name: Skitty
fact: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Delcatty
fact: The reason it does not have a nest is that it simply searches for a clean, comfortable place then sleeps there.

name: Sableye
fact: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

name: Mawile
fact: It has two mouths. The big jaws on the back of its head can't taste anything, so that's the mouth it uses to eat foods it doesn't like.

name: Aron
fact: It eats iron ore, and sometimes railroad tracks, to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

name: Lairon
fact: Lairon fight over territory, and when their steel bodies collide, sparks fly.

name: Aggron
fact: You can tell its age by the length of its iron horns. It claims an entire mountain as its territory.

name: Meditite
fact: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

name: Medicham
fact: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.

name: Electrike
fact: Friction between the air and its fur produces static electricity. When Electrike runs, it makes a crackling sound.

name: Manectric
fact: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

name: Plusle
fact: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

name: Minun
fact: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

name: Volbeat
fact: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves Illumise's sweet aroma.

name: Illumise
fact: Its fragrance attracts a swarm of Volbeat, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.

name: Roselia
fact: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the Roselia is.

name: Gulpin
fact: There is nothing its stomach can't digest. While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.

name: Swalot
fact: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.

name: Carvanha
fact: They're such cowards that they won't hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!

name: Sharpedo
fact: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as "The Bully of the Sea."

name: Wailmer
fact: It bounces playfully like a ball. The more seawater it swallows, the higher it bounces.

name: Wailord
fact: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

name: Numel
fact: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

name: Camerupt
fact: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years, or whenever it becomes really angry.

name: Torkoal
fact: You can tell how it's feeling by the smoke spouting from its shell. Tremendous velocity is a sign of good health.

name: Spoink
fact: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

name: Grumpig
fact: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

name: Spinda
fact: Its steps are staggering and unsteady, but Spinda thinks it's walking in a straight line.

name: Trapinch
fact: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

name: Vibrava
fact: It vibrates its wings to send out odd sound waves. Trainers who are with it need earplugs.

name: Flygon
fact: Known as "The Desert Spirit," this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

name: Cacnea
fact: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.

name: Cacturne
fact: During the daytime, Cacturne remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun.

name: Swablu
fact: Its wings are like cotton tufts. If it perches on someone's head, it looks like a cotton hat.

name: Altaria
fact: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you're in a dream.

name: Zangoose
fact: It's Seviper's archrival. To threaten those it encounters, it fans out the claws on its front paws.

name: Seviper
fact: For many generations, it has feuded with Zangoose. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.

name: Lunatone
fact: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

name: Solrock
fact: A new Pokémon species, rumored to be from the sun. It gives off light while spinning.

name: Barboach
fact: Its slippery body is hard to grasp, so much so that there are festivals where people compete to see how many they can catch barehanded.

name: Whiscash
fact: Sighting Whiscash leaping from the water is believed to herald an earthquake.

name: Corphish
fact: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

name: Crawdaunt
fact: Its temperament is rough and it loves to fight, but as soon as its pincers break off, it turns cowardly. It stays timid until they grow back.

name: Baltoy
fact: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

name: Claydol
fact: If it gets wet, its body melts. When rain starts to fall, it wraps its whole body up with its psychic powers to protect itself.

name: Lileep
fact: It sticks to rocks with its powerful suckers and can't be washed away no matter how rough the surf gets.

name: Cradily
fact: It lives in warm seas. Its heavy body weighs it down so it won't get washed away in rough weather.

name: Anorith
fact: This is one kind of primeval bug Pokémon. With eight wings, it could apparently swim a lot faster than you'd expect.

name: Armaldo
fact: Armaldo adapted from living in water to living on land. It has been determined that it is the ancestor of some bug Pokémon.

name: Feebas
fact: They look ragged, so no one catches them. They look like they'd taste bad, so predators won't eat them. And their numbers continue to grow.

name: Milotic
fact: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

name: Castform
fact: It has the ability to change its form into the sun, the rain, or a snow cloud, depending on the weather.

name: Kecleon
fact: It changes its hue to blend into its surroundings. If no one takes notice of it for too long, it will pout and never reveal itself.

name: Shuppet
fact: There's a proverb that says, "Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk."

name: Banette
fact: A stuffed toy that came to life. Treat it kindly and it may turn back into a cuddly toy.

name: Duskull
fact: Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks up to prey. It has the ability to slip through thick walls.

name: Dusclops
fact: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

name: Tropius
fact: Because it continually ate only its favorite fruit, the fruit started growing around its neck.

name: Chimecho
fact: It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.

name: Absol
fact: It senses coming disasters and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.

name: Wynaut
fact: Wynaut can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry.

name: Snorunt
fact: It's said that if they are seen at midnight, they'll cause heavy snow. They eat snow and ice to survive.

name: Glalie
fact: To protect itself, it clads its body in an armor of ice, made by freezing moisture in the air.

name: Spheal
fact: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.

name: Sealeo
fact: Be it Spheal or Poké Ball, it will spin any round object on its nose with the greatest of ease.

name: Walrein
fact: Walrein's tusks keep growing throughout its life. Tusks broken in battle will grow back to their usual impressive size in a year.

name: Clamperl
fact: It is protected by a sturdy shell. Once in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent pearl.

name: Huntail
fact: It lives deep in the sea where no light ever filters down. It lights up its small fishlike tail to attract prey.

name: Gorebyss
fact: Its pink body becomes more vivid with the rise of water temperatures in the springtime.

name: Relicanth
fact: The reason it hasn't changed at all in a hundred million years is that it's apparently already a perfect life-form.

name: Luvdisc
fact: During the spawning season, countless Luvdisc congregate at coral reefs, turning the waters pink.

name: Bagon
fact: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

name: Shelgon
fact: Shelgon lives deep within caves. It stays shut up in its hard shell, dreaming of the day it will be able to fly.

name: Salamence
fact: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.

name: Beldum
fact: Instead of blood, magnetism flows through its body. When it's feeling bad, try giving it a magnet.

name: Metang
fact: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won't be scratched if it collides with a jet.

name: Metagross
fact: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

name: Regirock
fact: It is entirely composed of rocks with no sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery even to modern scientists.

name: Regice
fact: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can't be melted, even by magma.

name: Registeel
fact: Registeel's body is made of a strange material that is flexible enough to stretch and shrink but also more durable than any metal.

name: Latias
fact: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

name: Latios
fact: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

name: Kyogre
fact: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

name: Groudon
fact: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

name: Rayquaza
fact: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

name: Jirachi
fact: It is said to make any wish come true. It is awake for only seven days out of a thousand years.

name: Deoxys
fact: It came to Earth on a meteor and can change its shape.

name: Turtwig
fact: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

name: Grotle
fact: Appears where there is clean spring water. The fruit that grows on the shrubs on its shell is sweet, nutritious, and truly delicious.

name: Torterra
fact: Groups of this Pokémon migrating in search of water have been mistaken for "moving forests."

name: Chimchar
fact: Full of vigor and always in high spirits. It was once known by the name "Lantern-Tail" and feared as some kind of apparition.

name: Monferno
fact: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.

name: Infernape
fact: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.

name: Piplup
fact: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

name: Prinplup
fact: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

name: Empoleon
fact: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

name: Starly
fact: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

name: Staravia
fact: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

name: Staraptor
fact: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

name: Bidoof
fact: There have been incidents involving Bidoof sauntering into villages and gnawing on the houses without a single care.

name: Bibarel
fact: A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.

name: Kricketot
fact: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

name: Kricketune
fact: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

name: Shinx
fact: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Luxio
fact: By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.

name: Luxray
fact: Luxray can see through solid objects. It will instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls, even if the walls are thick.

name: Budew
fact: This Pokémon is highly sensitive to temperature changes. When its bud starts to open, that means spring is right around the corner.

name: Roserade
fact: With the movements of a dancer, it strikes with whips that are densely lined with poison thorns.

name: Cranidos
fact: They duel each other by ramming their heads together, and the resulting sound echoes throughout the area like the pealing of a bell.

name: Rampardos
fact: In ancient times, people would dig up fossils of this Pokémon and use its skull, which is harder than steel, to make helmets.

name: Shieldon
fact: It habitually polishes its face by rubbing it against tree trunks. It is weak to attacks from behind.

name: Bastiodon
fact: When attacked, they form a wall with their shieldlike faces to protect their young.

name: Burmy
fact: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

name: Wormadam
fact: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.

name: Mothim
fact: While it loves floral honey, it won't gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from Combee.

name: Combee
fact: This Pokémon is a set of three. When they sleep, they gather up and form a giant hive of 100 Combee.

name: Vespiquen
fact: Vespiquen that give off more pheromones have larger swarms of Combee attendants.

name: Pachirisu
fact: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

name: Buizel
fact: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.

name: Floatzel
fact: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

name: Cherubi
fact: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

name: Cherrim
fact: It is docile as a bud, but turns cheerful when it blooms. It folds back into a bud if sunlight wanes.

name: Shellos
fact: Purple mucus sticks to the hands of anyone who touches it. Take care, as the substance is troublesome to wash off.

name: Gastrodon
fact: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

name: Ambipom
fact: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that's proof it really likes you.

name: Drifloon
fact: Perhaps seeking company, it approaches children. However, it often quickly runs away again when the children play too roughly with it.

name: Drifblim
fact: It's drowsy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

name: Buneary
fact: By extending its rolled-up ears and striking the ground, it can bound so high it surprises itself.

name: Lopunny
fact: Lopunny regrows its coat twice a year. Mufflers and hats made from its fur are really warm.

name: Mismagius
fact: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

name: Honchkrow
fact: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than a hundred of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.

name: Glameow
fact: When it's happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

name: Purugly
fact: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

name: Chingling
fact: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.

name: Stunky
fact: If it lifts its tail and points its rear at you, beware. It's about to spray you with a fluid stinky enough to make you faint.

name: Skuntank
fact: It sprays a stinky fluid from its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester.

name: Bronzor
fact: Polishing Bronzor to a shine makes its surface reflect the truth, according to common lore. Be that as it may, Bronzor hates being polished.

name: Bronzong
fact: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

name: Bonsly
fact: In order to adjust the level of fluids in its body, it exudes water from its eyes. This makes it appear to be crying.

name: Mime Jr.
fact: Known to turn up in bustling marketplaces now and again. It mimics people much as a child would, then watches how they react, eyes sparkling.

name: Happiny
fact: Usually it's a well-behaved Pokémon, but if you take its round rock away, it will cry and fuss and throw a big old tantrum.

name: Chatot
fact: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

name: Spiritomb
fact: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

name: Gible
fact: Its original home is an area much hotter than Alola. If you're planning to live with one, your heating bill will soar.

name: Gabite
fact: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

name: Garchomp
fact: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

name: Munchlax
fact: It hides food under its long fur, but it sometimes forgets about it and causes a stinky disturbance.

name: Riolu
fact: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

name: Lucario
fact: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

name: Hippopotas
fact: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.

name: Hippowdon
fact: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.

name: Skorupi
fact: It lives in arid regions and can go without food for a year while waiting for prey.

name: Drapion
fact: It's so vicious that it's called the Sand Demon. Yet when confronted by Hippowdon, Drapion keeps a low profile and will never pick a fight.

name: Croagunk
fact: Once diluted, its poison becomes medicinal. This Pokémon came into popularity after a pharmaceutical company chose it as a mascot.

name: Toxicroak
fact: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

name: Carnivine
fact: Hanging from branches using its tentacles, it looks like a plant. It awaits prey, mouth wide open.

name: Finneon
fact: When night falls, their pink patterns begin to shine. They're popular with divers, so there are resorts that feed them to keep them close.

name: Lumineon
fact: They traverse the deep waters as if crawling over the seafloor. The fantastic lights of its fins shine like stars in the night sky.

name: Mantyke
fact: It's highly friendly and easily tamed. Tours that take people swimming with Mantyke are a super-popular beach activity.

name: Snover
fact: The berries that grow around its belly are like ice pops. Other Pokémon love to snack on them.

name: Abomasnow
fact: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as "The Ice Monster."

name: Weavile
fact: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.

name: Magnezone
fact: Three units generate magnetism. There have been many mistaken reports of UFO sightings when Magnezone flies through the night sky.

name: Lickilicky
fact: A contest is under way to determine which one can stick its tongue out the farthest. The current record is...more than 82 feet.

name: Rhyperior
fact: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

name: Tangrowth
fact: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can't even see its eyes.

name: Electivire
fact: A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.

name: Magmortar
fact: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

name: Togekiss
fact: Known as a bringer of blessings, it's been depicted on good-luck charms since ancient times.

name: Yanmega
fact: The beat of its wings is so powerful that it accidentally dislodges full-grown trees when it takes off in flight.

name: Leafeon
fact: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you'll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

name: Glaceon
fact: The coldness emanating from Glaceon causes powdery snow to form, making it quite a popular Pokémon at ski resorts.

name: Gliscor
fact: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.

name: Mamoswine
fact: A frozen one was dug up from soil dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement.

name: Porygon-Z
fact: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.

name: Gallade
fact: True to its honorable-warrior image, it uses the blades on its elbows only in defense of something or someone.

name: Probopass
fact: Although it can control its units known as Mini-Noses, they sometimes get lost and don't come back.

name: Dusknoir
fact: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

name: Froslass
fact: On snowy nights it sneaks into towns to play icy pranks. What looks like its body is actually hollow.

name: Rotom
fact: With a body made of plasma, it can inhabit all sorts of machines. It loves to surprise others.

name: Uxie
fact: When Uxie flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge.

name: Mesprit
fact: When Mesprit flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.

name: Azelf
fact: When Azelf flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.

name: Dialga
fact: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when Dialga's heart beats.

name: Palkia
fact: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with Palkia's every breath.

name: Heatran
fact: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

name: Regigigas
fact: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

name: Giratina
fact: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.

name: Cresselia
fact: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Phione
fact: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

name: Manaphy
fact: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Darkrai
fact: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

name: Shaymin
fact: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

name: Arceus
fact: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

name: Victini
fact: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Snivy
fact: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

name: Servine
fact: When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

name: Serperior
fact: It can stop its opponents' movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

name: Tepig
fact: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

name: Pignite
fact: Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

name: Emboar
fact: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

name: Oshawott
fact: The scalchop on its stomach isn't just used for battle—it can be used to break open hard berries as well.

name: Dewott
fact: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

name: Samurott
fact: In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.

name: Patrat
fact: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won't notice a foe coming from behind.

name: Watchog
fact: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

name: Lillipup
fact: Because it doesn't yelp, it's extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.

name: Herdier
fact: Herdier is a very smart and friendly Pokémon. So much so that there's a theory that Herdier was the first Pokémon to partner with people.

name: Stoutland
fact: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It's said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.

name: Purrloin
fact: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

name: Liepard
fact: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

name: Pansage
fact: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

name: Simisage
fact: It strikes its enemies with a thorn-covered tail. The leaf on its head is bitter.

name: Pansear
fact: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

name: Simisear
fact: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

name: Panpour
fact: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

name: Simipour
fact: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

name: Munna
fact: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it's eating a good dream, and black when it's eating a nightmare.

name: Musharna
fact: With the mist from its forehead, it can create shapes of things from dreams it has eaten.

name: Pidove
fact: It's forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.

name: Tranquill
fact: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.

name: Unfezant
fact: Males swing the plumage on their heads to threaten others, but females are better at flying.

name: Blitzle
fact: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

name: Zebstrika
fact: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Roggenrola
fact: The hexagonal hole is its ear. Deep in that ear is an energy core, so if you stick your hand in there, Roggenrola will be very angry!

name: Boldore
fact: Its orange crystal is a mass of energy. Just one crystal fragment would provide enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks.

name: Gigalith
fact: Known for its hefty horsepower, this Pokémon is a popular partner for construction workers.

name: Woobat
fact: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it's evidence that Woobat live there.

name: Swoobat
fact: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon's nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

name: Drilbur
fact: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

name: Excadrill
fact: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

name: Audino
fact: Audino's sense of hearing is superb. Not even a pebble rolling along over a mile away will escape Audino's ears.

name: Timburr
fact: It loves helping out with construction projects. It loves it so much that if rain causes work to halt, it swings its log around and throws a tantrum.

name: Gurdurr
fact: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

name: Conkeldurr
fact: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

name: Tympole
fact: Graceful ripples running across the water's surface are a sure sign that Tympole are singing in high-pitched voices below.

name: Palpitoad
fact: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

name: Seismitoad
fact: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

name: Throh
fact: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

name: Sawk
fact: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

name: Sewaddle
fact: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

name: Swadloon
fact: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

name: Leavanny
fact: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

name: Venipede
fact: Venipede and Sizzlipede are similar species, but when the two meet, a huge fight ensues.

name: Whirlipede
fact: This Pokémon spins itself rapidly and charges into its opponents. Its top speed is just over 60 mph.

name: Scolipede
fact: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

name: Cottonee
fact: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

name: Whimsicott
fact: This nuisance sneaks into people's homes, where it hides important things and scatters cotton all over the place.

name: Petilil
fact: By pruning the leaves on its head with regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into a fine plump shape.

name: Lilligant
fact: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

name: Basculin
fact: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.

name: Sandile
fact: The desert gets cold at night, so when the sun sets, this Pokémon burrows deep into the sand and sleeps until sunrise.

name: Krokorok
fact: Thanks to the special membrane covering its eyes, it can see its surroundings clearly, even in the middle of the night.

name: Krookodile
fact: It can expand the focus of its eyes, enabling it to see objects in the far distance as if it were using binoculars.

name: Darumaka
fact: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

name: Darmanitan
fact: When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.

name: Maractus
fact: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

name: Dwebble
fact: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.

name: Crustle
fact: This highly territorial Pokémon prefers dry climates. It won't come out of its boulder on rainy days.

name: Scraggy
fact: It stretches its saggy skin up to its neck to protect itself. The saggier their skin, the more respect they garner.

name: Scrafty
fact: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.

name: Sigilyph
fact: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.

name: Yamask
fact: It wanders old ruins at night, carrying a mask it takes very good care of.

name: Cofagrigus
fact: They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

name: Tirtouga
fact: Reputed to be the ancestor of most turtle Pokémon, it lived in warm seas approximately a hundred million years ago.

name: Carracosta
fact: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

name: Archen
fact: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. As research suggested, Archen is unable to fly. But it's very good at jumping.

name: Archeops
fact: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.

name: Trubbish
fact: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Garbodor
fact: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

name: Zorua
fact: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

name: Zoroark
fact: It doesn't just transform itself—it also has the power to make hundreds of people see its illusions.

name: Minccino
fact: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

name: Cinccino
fact: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

name: Gothita
fact: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

name: Gothorita
fact: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

name: Gothitelle
fact: It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikes conflict. It's also able to predict the future based on the movement of the stars.

name: Solosis
fact: Many say that the special liquid covering this Pokémon's body would allow it to survive in the vacuum of space.

name: Duosion
fact: Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.

name: Reuniclus
fact: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

name: Ducklett
fact: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Swanna
fact: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Vanillite
fact: When the morning sun hit an icicle, it wished not to melt, and thus Vanillite was born.

name: Vanillish
fact: This hearty Pokémon survived the Ice Age. It's incredibly popular in very hot regions.

name: Vanilluxe
fact: It blasts blizzards from its two mouths. It can create snow anywhere, so it gets a lot of love from skiers and snowboarders.

name: Deerling
fact: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

name: Sawsbuck
fact: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

name: Emolga
fact: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can't fly properly.

name: Karrablast
fact: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

name: Escavalier
fact: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

name: Foongus
fact: No one knows what the Poké Ball–like pattern on Foongus means or why Foongus has it.

name: Amoonguss
fact: Amoonguss generally doesn't move much. It tends to stand still near Poké Balls that have been dropped on the ground.

name: Frillish
fact: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

name: Jellicent
fact: Most of this Pokémon's body composition is identical to sea water. It makes sunken ships its lair.

name: Alomomola
fact: Fishermen take them along on long voyages, because if you have an Alomomola with you, there'll be no need for a doctor or medicine.

name: Joltik
fact: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

name: Galvantula
fact: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

name: Ferroseed
fact: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

name: Ferrothorn
fact: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.

name: Klink
fact: It's suspected that Klink were the inspiration behind ancient people's invention of the first gears.

name: Klang
fact: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.

name: Klinklang
fact: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

name: Tynamo
fact: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Eelektrik
fact: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

name: Eelektross
fact: It latches on to prey with its sucker mouth, sinking in its fangs and shocking the prey with powerful electricity.

name: Elgyem
fact: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.

name: Beheeyem
fact: Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three fingers, but those patterns haven't been decoded.

name: Litwick
fact: Its little flame glows to light the way through dark rooms.

name: Lampent
fact: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp.

name: Chandelure
fact: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

name: Axew
fact: Its large tusks have a tendency to break, but each time they grow back, they grow in harder and sturdier.

name: Fraxure
fact: A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.

name: Haxorus
fact: Its resilient tusks are its pride and joy. It licks up dirt to take in the minerals it needs to keep its tusks in top condition.

name: Cubchoo
fact: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

name: Beartic
fact: It swims energetically through frigid seas. When it gets tired, it freezes the seawater with its breath so it can rest on the ice.

name: Cryogonal
fact: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

name: Shelmet
fact: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

name: Accelgor
fact: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

name: Stunfisk
fact: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: Mienfoo
fact: In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chop with its arms more than 100 times.

name: Mienshao
fact: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

name: Druddigon
fact: Druddigon lives in caves, but it never skips sunbathing—it won't be able to move if its body gets too cold.

name: Golett
fact: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

name: Golurk
fact: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

name: Pawniard
fact: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

name: Bisharp
fact: No matter how strong the Bisharp, it's said that if the blade on its head is chipped, it will retire from its position as the boss.

name: Bouffalant
fact: They are known to charge so wildly that if a train were to enter their territory, they would send it flying.

name: Rufflet
fact: If it spies a strong Pokémon, Rufflet can't resist challenging it to a battle. But if Rufflet loses, it starts bawling.

name: Braviary
fact: Known as "the hero of the skies," this Pokémon is so proud and so brave that it will never retreat, even when it's injured.

name: Vullaby
fact: It wears a bone to protect its rear. It often squabbles with others of its kind over particularly comfy bones.

name: Mandibuzz
fact: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

name: Heatmor
fact: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.

name: Durant
fact: Durant dig nests in mountains. They build their complicated, interconnected tunnels into mazes.

name: Deino
fact: Because it can't see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

name: Zweilous
fact: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

name: Hydreigon
fact: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon eats everything in its path!

name: Larvesta
fact: The people of ancient times believed that Larvesta fell from the sun.

name: Volcarona
fact: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

name: Cobalion
