fact: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.

name: Terrakion
fact: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

name: Virizion
fact: A legend tells of this Pokémon working together with Cobalion and Terrakion to protect the Pokémon of the Unova region.

name: Tornadus
fact: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

name: Thundurus
fact: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

name: Reshiram
fact: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

name: Zekrom
fact: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

name: Landorus
fact: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

name: Kyurem
fact: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

name: Keldeo
fact: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

name: Meloetta
fact: Many famous songs have been inspired by the melodies that Meloetta plays.

name: Genesect
fact: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Chespin
fact: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn't faze it.

name: Quilladin
fact: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights.

name: Chesnaught
fact: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

name: Fennekin
fact: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

name: Braixen
fact: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

name: Delphox
fact: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

name: Froakie
fact: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Frogadier
fact: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

name: Greninja
fact: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

name: Bunnelby
fact: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

name: Diggersby
fact: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it's finished digging, it lounges lazily.

name: Fletchling
fact: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

name: Fletchinder
fact: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.

name: Talonflame
fact: Its tough wings don't allow fire to pass through them. A long time ago, firefighters' outfits were made from Talonflame wings.

name: Scatterbug
fact: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

name: Spewpa
fact: The beaks of bird Pokémon can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

name: Vivillon
fact: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.

name: Litleo
fact: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

name: Pyroar
fact: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

name: Flabébé
fact: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it's collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

name: Floette
fact: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.

name: Florges
fact: In times long past, governors of castles would invite Florges to create flower gardens to embellish the castle domains.

name: Skiddo
fact: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

name: Gogoat
fact: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.

name: Pancham
fact: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can't help grinning if anyone pats its head.

name: Pangoro
fact: This rowdy Pokémon boasts great physical strength. Many Trainers are also smitten by its lively character.

name: Furfrou
fact: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Espurr
fact: Though Espurr's expression never changes, behind that blank stare is an intense struggle to contain its devastating psychic power.

name: Meowstic
fact: Revealing the eyelike patterns on the insides of its ears will unleash its psychic powers. It normally keeps the patterns hidden, however.

name: Honedge
fact: The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the true body of Honedge.

name: Doublade
fact: Honedge evolves into twins. The two blades rub together to emit a metallic sound that unnerves opponents.

name: Aegislash
fact: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

name: Spritzee
fact: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked.

name: Aromatisse
fact: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.

name: Swirlix
fact: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn't get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.

name: Slurpuff
fact: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

name: Inkay
fact: When exchanging information with others of its kind, it flashes the light-emitting spots on its body in a complex rhythm.

name: Malamar
fact: It's said that Malamar's hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

name: Binacle
fact: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

name: Barbaracle
fact: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

name: Skrelp
fact: It's not good at swimming, so it clings to the seaweed.

name: Dragalge
fact: Dragalge generates dragon energy by sticking the plume on its head out above the ocean's surface and bathing it in sunlight.

name: Clauncher
fact: It moves around by jetting water from its right pincer. It has a poor sense of balance, so it's terrible at swimming straight.

name: Clawitzer
fact: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots.

name: Helioptile
fact: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

name: Heliolisk
fact: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

name: Tyrunt
fact: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

name: Tyrantrum
fact: Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100 million years ago, so it behaved like a king.

name: Amaura
fact: It lived in cold areas in ancient times. It's said that when Amaura whinnies, auroras appear in the night sky.

name: Aurorus
fact: An Aurorus was found frozen solid within a glacier, just as it appeared long ago, which became quite a big event in the news.

name: Sylveon
fact: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.

name: Hawlucha
fact: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

name: Dedenne
fact: It sneaks into people's homes and steals electricity from their outlets. When your electric bill seems off, it's the handiwork of this rascal.

name: Carbink
fact: Some say that deep beneath the surface of the world, a pack of Carbink live with their queen in a kingdom of jewels.

name: Goomy
fact: It's covered in a slimy membrane that makes any punches or kicks slide off it harmlessly.

name: Sliggoo
fact: Its four horns are a high-performance radar system. It uses them to sense sounds and smells, rather than using ears or a nose.

name: Goodra
fact: It's very friendly toward people. If you grow close to it, Goodra will hug you with its sticky, slime-covered body. Don't get mad.

name: Klefki
fact: This Pokémon is constantly collecting keys. Entrust a Klefki with important keys, and the Pokémon will protect them no matter what.

name: Phantump
fact: It calls out in the forest because it wants to make friends. Its leaves can be brewed into medicine.

name: Trevenant
fact: It's feared as a ghost of the forest. Lumberjacks bring along Fire types, which Trevenant hates, when they enter the forest.

name: Pumpkaboo
fact: A friendly spirit lives in its pumpkin body. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

name: Gourgeist
fact: It sings spooky songs as it wanders the town streets on moonless nights.

name: Bergmite
fact: This Pokémon lives in areas of frigid cold. It secures itself to the back of an Avalugg by freezing its feet in place.

name: Avalugg
fact: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back makes it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice.

name: Noibat
fact: Fruits are its favorite foods. This gourmet carefully picks out just the ripe ones using its sonar.

name: Noivern
fact: Although it has a violent disposition, if you give it a nice ripe fruit that it loves, Noivern will suddenly become tame.

name: Xerneas
fact: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

name: Yveltal
fact: When this legendary Pokémon spreads its wings and tail feathers wide, they glow a brilliant red.

name: Zygarde
fact: When the Kalos region's ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.

name: Diancie
fact: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

name: Hoopa
fact: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

name: Volcanion
fact: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

name: Rowlet
fact: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to use its Trainer's pocket or bag as a nest.

name: Dartrix
fact: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don't groom it diligently, it will stop listening to you.

name: Decidueye
fact: Decidueye can nock and fire an arrow at an enemy in a tenth of a second, so its battles are decided in the blink of an eye.

name: Litten
fact: Its coat regrows twice a year. When the time comes, Litten sets its own body on fire and burns away the old fur.

name: Torracat
fact: When its mane is standing on end, you can tell it's feeling good. When it isn't feeling well, its fur will lie down flat.

name: Incineroar
fact: Incineroar's rough and aggressive behavior is its most notable trait, but the way it helps out small Pokémon shows that it has a kind side as well.

name: Popplio
fact: Popplio gets on top of its bouncy water balloons to jump higher. It's quite the acrobatic fighter!

name: Brionne
fact: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance to try and help.

name: Primarina
fact: Also known as a songstress, it has a fantastical look on moonlit nights when it leads its colony in song.

name: Pikipek
fact: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

name: Trumbeak
fact: It can bend the tip of its beak to produce over a hundred different cries at will.

name: Toucannon
fact: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

name: Yungoos
fact: It wanders around in a never-ending search for food. At dusk, it collapses from exhaustion and falls asleep on the spot.

name: Gumshoos
fact: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it's always snoozing by nightfall.

name: Grubbin
fact: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

name: Charjabug
fact: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.

name: Vikavolt
fact: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.

name: Crabrawler
fact: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.

name: Crabominable
fact: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.

name: Oricorio
fact: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

name: Cutiefly
fact: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

name: Ribombee
fact: Rain makes pollen damp, so Ribombee hates rain. When it sees ominous clouds, it finds a hollow in a tree, where it waits stock-still.

name: Rockruff
fact: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

name: Lycanroc
fact: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.

name: Wishiwashi
fact: When it's in a jam, its shining eyes attract others of its kind. The light from its eyes is visible almost 25 miles away.

name: Mareanie
fact: Aside from its head, its body parts grow back quickly. After a good night's sleep, Mareanie is back to normal.

name: Toxapex
fact: With its 12 legs, it creates a dome to shelter within. The flow of the tides doesn't affect Toxapex in there, so it's very comfortable.

name: Mudbray
fact: It loves playing in the mud. If it isn't showered with mud on a daily basis, it gets stressed out and stops listening to its Trainer.

name: Mudsdale
fact: Mudsdale has so much stamina that it could carry over 10 tons across the Galar region without rest or sleep.

name: Dewpider
fact: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other's way.

name: Araquanid
fact: It has a habit of storing things it values in its water bubble. If its Trainer doesn't watch out, Araquanid will try to put them in its bubble!

name: Fomantis
fact: It loves the sunshine. When it basks in the sunlight regularly, it grows up with vivid coloration.

name: Lurantis
fact: This Pokémon resembles a beautiful flower. A properly raised Lurantis will have gorgeous, brilliant colors.

name: Morelull
fact: It likes damp dark places. When night falls, the spores filling the caps of its mushrooms glow.

name: Shiinotic
fact: If you see a light deep in a forest at night, don't go near. Shiinotic will make you fall fast asleep.

name: Salandit
fact: It weakens opponents and sends them reeling with its poisonous gas. Salandit doesn't deal well with Spinda, since it's always reeling.

name: Salazzle
fact: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted to use in the production of luscious perfumes.

name: Stufful
fact: Stufful hates to be hugged or touched in any way. It will squirm, thrash, and resist with amazing power.

name: Bewear
fact: It boasts tremendous physical strength. Many people call it the most dangerous Pokémon in the Alola region.

name: Bounsweet
fact: Although it's too sugary for human consumption, Bounsweet's sweat can be watered down into a juice with just the right amount of sweetness.

name: Steenee
fact: As it twirls like a dancer, a sweet smell spreads out around it. Anyone who inhales the scent will feel a surge of happiness.

name: Tsareena
fact: A Pokémon known for the beauty of its well-shaped legs, it sometimes appears as a mascot in advertisements for beauty salons.

name: Comfey
fact: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

name: Oranguru
fact: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

name: Passimian
fact: Berries are its weapons as well as the staple of its diet. The one that can throw a berry the farthest is the boss of the troop.

name: Wimpod
fact: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

name: Golisopod
fact: It battles skillfully with its six arms, but spends most of its time peacefully meditating in caves deep beneath the sea.

name: Sandygast
fact: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.

name: Palossand
fact: This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hates water. Palossand can't maintain its castle-like shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.

name: Pyukumuku
fact: Its entire body is covered in its own slime. If you accidentally step on one, you'll slip, and it will get mad and smack you!

name: Type: Null
fact: There's danger of its going on a rampage, so its true power is sealed away beneath its control mask.

name: Silvally
fact: A solid bond of trust between this Pokémon and its Trainer awakened the strength hidden within Silvally. It can change its type at will.

name: Minior
fact: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.

name: Komala
fact: The log it holds was given to it by its parents at birth. It has also been known to cling to the arm of a friendly Trainer.

name: Turtonator
fact: Its exploding shell poses a real danger but is sensitive to moisture. On rainy days, Turtonator takes silent refuge in caves.

name: Togedemaru
fact: Its capacity to produce electricity is somewhat limited, so it gets charged up by letting lightning strike it!

name: Mimikyu
fact: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.

name: Bruxish
fact: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

name: Drampa
fact: It appears in towns and plays with the children. Drampa will protect kids when they're in danger, so their moms don't have to worry.

name: Dhelmise
fact: Its chain-like green seaweed can stretch outward for hundreds of yards. For some reason, it gets along well with Skrelp.

name: Jangmo-o
fact: They learn to fight by smashing their head scales together. The dueling strengthens both their skills and their spirits.

name: Hakamo-o
fact: The scales it sheds can be molded and processed to make pots and pans. They conduct heat well, so they're a popular item.

name: Kommo-o
fact: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.

name: Tapu Koko
fact: It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.

name: Tapu Lele
fact: As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.

name: Tapu Bulu
fact: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around.

name: Tapu Fini
fact: The guardian deity of Poni, it can control water. People say it can create pure water that will wash away any uncleanness.

name: Cosmog
fact: This Pokémon came from another universe. Its gaseous body is so light that even a gentle breeze can blow it away.

name: Cosmoem
fact: The absorption of starlight fuels this Pokémon's growth. The shell that encases it is harder than any known material.

name: Solgaleo
fact: When light radiates from its body, this Pokémon could almost appear to be the sun. It will dispel any darkness and light up the world.

name: Lunala
fact: It steals the light from its surroundings and then becomes the full moon, showering its own light across the night sky.

name: Nihilego
fact: One of the Ultra Beasts. It came from another world and floats along like a jellyfish.

name: Buzzwole
fact: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Pheromosa
fact: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.

name: Xurkitree
fact: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so people think it energizes itself with electricity.

name: Celesteela
fact: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.

name: Kartana
fact: One of the Ultra Beast life-forms, it was observed cutting down a gigantic steel tower with one stroke of its blade.

name: Guzzlord
fact: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.

name: Necrozma
fact: It survives by absorbing light. After a long time spent slumbering underground, impurities accumulated within it, causing its body to darken.

name: Magearna
fact: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

name: Marshadow
fact: By slipping into the shadow of a martial arts master and copying their movements, this Pokémon learned the ultimate techniques.

name: Poipole
fact: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

name: Naganadel
fact: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

name: Stakataka
fact: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

name: Blacephalon
fact: It juggles its fiery head like a circus clown. It's one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Zeraora
fact: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes.

name: Meltan
fact: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

name: Melmetal
fact: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal's heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.

name: Grookey
fact: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.

name: Thwackey
fact: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

name: Rillaboom
fact: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

name: Scorbunny
fact: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

name: Raboot
fact: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

name: Cinderace
fact: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball.

name: Sobble
fact: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

name: Drizzile
fact: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

name: Inteleon
fact: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

name: Skwovet
fact: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

name: Greedent
fact: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly.

name: Rookidee
fact: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful.

name: Corvisquire
fact: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

name: Corviknight
fact: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region's airborne taxi service.

name: Blipbug
fact: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

name: Dottler
fact: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

name: Orbeetle
fact: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

name: Nickit
fact: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others.

name: Thievul
fact: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

name: Gossifleur
fact: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Eldegoss
fact: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

name: Wooloo
fact: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

name: Dubwool
fact: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline.

name: Chewtle
fact: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

name: Drednaw
fact: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

name: Yamper
fact: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Boltund
fact: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

name: Rolycoly
fact: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

name: Carkol
fact: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

name: Coalossal
fact: While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

name: Applin
fact: It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

name: Flapple
fact: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

name: Appletun
fact: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back smells just like apples.

name: Silicobra
fact: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

name: Sandaconda
fact: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

name: Cramorant
fact: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

name: Arrokuda
fact: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw.

name: Barraskewda
fact: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel.

name: Toxel
fact: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

name: Toxtricity
fact: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

name: Sizzlipede
fact: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

name: Centiskorch
fact: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Clobbopus
fact: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles.

name: Grapploct
fact: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

name: Sinistea
fact: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.

name: Polteageist
fact: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.

name: Hatenna
fact: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

name: Hattrem
fact: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

name: Hatterene
fact: This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

name: Impidimp
fact: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

name: Morgrem
fact: It loves to play sly pranks in the woods. Some believe it has the power to make crops grow.

name: Grimmsnarl
fact: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

name: Obstagoon
fact: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

name: Perrserker
fact: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

name: Cursola
fact: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You'll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

name: Sirfetch’d
fact: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

name: Mr. Rime
fact: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

name: Runerigus
fact: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

name: Milcery
fact: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

name: Alcremie
fact: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

name: Falinks
fact: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

name: Pincurchin
fact: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.

name: Snom
fact: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.

name: Frosmoth
fact: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains.

name: Stonjourner
fact: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

name: Eiscue
fact: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

name: Indeedee
fact: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

name: Morpeko
fact: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they're precious treasures.

name: Cufant
fact: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

name: Copperajah
fact: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

name: Dracozolt
fact: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.

name: Arctozolt
fact: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

name: Dracovish
fact: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can't breathe unless it's underwater.

name: Arctovish
fact: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

name: Duraludon
fact: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

name: Dreepy
fact: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

name: Drakloak
fact: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

name: Dragapult
fact: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult's horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

name: Zacian
fact: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it's Zamazenta's elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.

name: Zamazenta
fact: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.

name: Eternatus
fact: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.

name: Kubfu
fact: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.

name: Urshifu
fact: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

name: Zarude
fact: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

name: Regieleki
fact: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar's electricity.

name: Regidrago
fact: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

name: Glastrier
fact: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.

name: Spectrier
fact: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn't use its sense of sight.

name: Calyrex
fact: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times.

name: Wyrdeer
fact: The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

name: Kleavor
fact: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone.

name: Ursaluna
fact: Hisui's swampy land made it big and strong. It can scoop up mud and peat with ease.

name: Basculegion
fact: No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

name: Sneasler
fact: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands.

name: Overqwil
fact: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend."

name: Enamorus
fact: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end.

name: Sprigatito
fact: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

name: Floragato
fact: When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

name: Meowscarada
fact: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

name: Fuecoco
fact: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

name: Crocalor
fact: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

name: Skeledirge
fact: Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it.

name: Quaxly
fact: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

name: Quaxwell
fact: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

name: Quaquaval
fact: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

name: Lechonk
fact: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

name: Oinkologne
fact: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

name: Tarountula
fact: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

name: Spidops
fact: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.

name: Nymble
fact: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

name: Lokix
fact: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode.

name: Pawmi
fact: Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Pawmo
fact: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

name: Pawmot
fact: Pawmot's fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

name: Tandemaus
fact: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

name: Maushold
fact: The two little ones just appeared one day. The group might be a family of related Pokémon, but nobody knows for sure.

name: Fidough
fact: The yeast in Fidough's breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

name: Dachsbun
fact: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

name: Smoliv
fact: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head.

name: Dolliv
fact: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

name: Arboliva
fact: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

name: Squawkabilly
fact: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.

name: Nacli
fact: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind.

name: Naclstack
fact: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

name: Garganacl
fact: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

name: Charcadet
fact: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Armarouge
fact: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

name: Ceruledge
fact: An old suit of armor came to life as this Pokémon. Blazing blue blades burn on its arms.

name: Tadbulb
fact: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

name: Bellibolt
fact: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt's belly-button dynamo.

name: Wattrel
fact: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity.

name: Kilowattrel
fact: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

name: Maschiff
fact: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.

name: Mabosstiff
fact: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

name: Shroodle
fact: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

name: Grafaiai
fact: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

name: Bramblin
fact: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

name: Brambleghast
fact: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

name: Toedscool
fact: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

name: Toedscruel
fact: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

name: Klawf
fact: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

name: Capsakid
fact: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

name: Scovillain
fact: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

name: Rellor
fact: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

name: Rabsca
fact: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

name: Flittle
fact: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

name: Espathra
fact: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

name: Tinkatink
fact: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.

name: Tinkatuff
fact: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other's hammers by smashing them together.

name: Tinkaton
fact: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

name: Wiglett
fact: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species.

name: Wugtrio
fact: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

name: Bombirdier
fact: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

name: Finizen
fact: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail.

name: Palafin
fact: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

name: Varoom
fact: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

name: Revavroom
fact: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders—now numbering eight—to generate energy.

name: Cyclizar
fact: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times.

name: Orthworm
fact: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

name: Glimmet
fact: Glimmet's toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

name: Glimmora
fact: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.

name: Greavard
fact: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

name: Houndstone
fact: Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

name: Flamigo
fact: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

name: Cetoddle
fact: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

name: Cetitan
fact: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

name: Veluza
fact: Veluza can heal itself very quickly. It slims down to boost its speed, then charges at its prey.

name: Dondozo
fact: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

name: Tatsugiri
fact: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

name: Annihilape
fact: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.

name: Clodsire
fact: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.

name: Farigiraf
fact: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

name: Dudunsparce
fact: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

name: Kingambit
fact: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

name: Great Tusk
fact: This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.

name: Scream Tail
fact: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.

name: Brute Bonnet
fact: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

name: Flutter Mane
fact: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

name: Slither Wing
fact: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.

name: Sandy Shocks
fact: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

name: Iron Treads
fact: This Pokémon closely resembles a scientific weapon that a paranormal magazine claimed was sent to this planet by aliens.

name: Iron Bundle
fact: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.

name: Iron Hands
fact: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.

name: Iron Jugulis
fact: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.

name: Iron Moth
fact: This Pokémon resembles an unknown object described in a paranormal magazine as a UFO sent to observe humanity.

name: Iron Thorns
fact: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.

name: Frigibax
fact: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

name: Arctibax
fact: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air.

name: Baxcalibur
fact: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

name: Gimmighoul
fact: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it's actually a Pokémon.

name: Gholdengo
fact: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.

name: Wo-Chien
fact: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

name: Chien-Pao
fact: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.

name: Ting-Lu
fact: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

name: Chi-Yu
fact: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

name: Roaring Moon
fact: A mysterious Pokémon that looks like an ancient Salamence. It lives deep inside the great crater of Paldea.

name: Iron Valiant
fact: It has some similarities to a mad scientist's invention covered in a paranormal magazine.

name: Koraidon
fact: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

name: Miraidon
fact: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

name: Walking Wake
fact: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.

name: Iron Leaves
fact: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

name: Dipplin
fact: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

name: Poltchageist
fact: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

name: Sinistcha
fact: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards.

name: Okidogi
fact: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

name: Munkidori
fact: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

name: Fezandipiti
fact: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

name: Ogerpon
fact: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

name: Archaludon
fact: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It's so durable that being caught in a cave-in won't faze it.

name: Hydrapple
fact: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.

name: Gouging Fire
fact: It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.

name: Raging Bolt
fact: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.

name: Iron Boulder
fact: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

name: Iron Crown
fact: It resembles a mysterious object introduced in a paranormal magazine as a cutting-edge weapon shaped like a Cobalion.

name: Terapagos
fact: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.

name: Pecharunt
fact: It hides inside its hard, peach-shaped shell and loves making sticky mochi.
